Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning retention of records regarding child abuse and neglect.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to retention of records regarding child abuse andneglect; and adding a new section to chapter 26.44 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 26.44 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Except as provided in RCW 26.44.031, the department shallretain records regarding child abuse or neglect referrals that resultin a finding of inconclusive or for which there is not sufficientevidence to make a determination, for not less than twenty years. Thedepartment shall retain indefinitely the records regarding: (a) Referrals that result in a founded complaint or for which theevidence indicates that more likely than not the abuse or neglectallegations were accurate; and (b) Referrals that result in a termination of parental rights. (2) Records must be maintained in such a manner that the departmentcan identify persons by name and date of birth, or by any other meanspermitted by law. The department shall conduct a search of the records p. 1 HB 3153retained under this section for decisions related to child carelicenses, adoptions, and outofhome placements.
